summary: All 5 learner profiles produce appropriate, evidence-based coaching outputs. Sparse learners receive safe fallbacks and concept-only guidance. Active learners get full coaching with action plans. Improving learners show positive trend language. Misconception-heavy learners trigger wrong-choice coaching and recovery sets. Long-history learners benefit from EWMA time-weighting and multi-window evidence categorization. No prediction or readiness language is emitted for any profile.
